feeds.title: Skywalk Paragliders
feeds.description: For more than a decade, the heads of skywalk have dealt with the system of flexible flying. The methods have changed dramatically since then, but the passion of the makers has remained the same. Whether a linens specialist or test pilots, every skywalk associate is an absolute specialist in his field.

feeds.title: Dust of the Universe Blog
feeds.description: This blog is dedicated for testing recent paragliders and flying gear. I have been flying since 1992, I am always in a rush to try new gliders as the feeling I get in exchanging wings is for me a unique experience This blog is dedicated for testing recent paragliders and flying gear. I share in this reviews of my paragliding experiences.

feeds.title: ROCK THE OUTDOOR
feeds.description: Follow the news magazine ROCK THE OUTDOOR to discover videos, infos, tips and reports on paragliding.

feeds.title: Many Feather Paragliding Blog
feeds.description: Many Feathers Paragliding School is a premier paragliding school in the adventure sports industry, offering comprehensive paragliding services. Follow their latest Paragliding activities and news updates via this blog.

feeds.title: Paranauten.com
feeds.description: Paranauten.com is a blog for paragliders, paragliders and paragliders. Here, experiences, equipment such as flight areas are reported.

feeds.title: Joe Onofrio Powered Paragliding
feeds.description: This blog documents my experiences with powered paragliding since 2005. I started it as a training tool for myself and to share photos with my friends and fellow pilots The bulk of the material is strait forward flight log entries but occasionally I got inspired and expand on the experience. Lately I've added bits from previous logs, trip dairies and old photographs.

feeds.title: FlyinOrange Blog
feeds.description: Globe trotting paraglider pilot in search of coaches, courses, and comps.

feeds.title: justACRO.com
feeds.description: justACRO.com, the acro paragliding portal serves as the main website of acrobatic paraglider pilots. Large collection of videos, forum, second hand market, acro trick descriptions, glider and harness database, startplace catalog and more.

feeds.title: 365hops Blog » Paragliding
feeds.description: 365hops is a location and interest based crowd-sharing platform for adventure, experiential and off-beat travel activities and aims to be one stop solution for off-beat travel in the near future. Their mission is to connect like minded people who are interested in travel and adventure activities which are happening around.

feeds.title: Kamshet Paragliding Adventure
feeds.description: Explore the thrilling world of Paragliding Kamshet with wonder experiences, stories, and Paragliding essential information provided in this blog. Paragliding Pune is a team of experts as well as certified pilots with paragliding pilot certification from world-renowned institutes.

feeds.title: Advance paragliders in the West Country
feeds.description: I'm Tim Pentreath and I've been paragliding since 1990 and have been flying Advance wings since 1998 when Gavin Foster sold me a second-hand Omega 4. Over the years I've flown in a number of comps - BPC and British Opens - and in 2014 I flew in both rounds of the British Champs for the first time and won the Sports Class in Ager and came 3rd place in the Championships in Sports Class.

feeds.title: Sharemyjoys
feeds.description: Sharemyjoys is a blog by Nick Neynens about paragliding vol bivouac in the mountains, photos and position updates.

feeds.title: Madcity Paragliding Blog
feeds.description: Paul Cooley is a USPPA Certified PPG Instructor and admitted 'adventure addict'. He is also known as the Adventure Pimp as he has been pimping all kinds of adventures. Madcity Paragliding offers Powered Paragliding instruction and sales for both Foot and Wheel Launch flying.

feeds.title: Icarus Tandem Paragliding Blog
feeds.description: Icarus Tandem Paragliding based in Cape Town started sharing the love with family and friends, they started introducing their loved ones to tandem paragliding.

feeds.title: Wind, I Like You
feeds.description: My name is Gorgi Ristovski I am from Skopje, Macedonia. I discovered paragliding when I was 18 years old and there has not been a day without thinking about it. Since the start I was addicted to the never ending challenge of understanding the sky as well as the quest of becoming a better and safer pilot.

feeds.title: Yassen Savov
feeds.description: I fly paragliders. This is what I do and what this website is mostly about. I learned how to paraglide at the age of 15. Since then much has changed, but not my love for this most simple way of getting high. The addiction stays strong. Self-expression in the air, drawing some beautiful lines, and having fun with a hundred of my friends in some of the most beautiful places on earth.

feeds.title: Nylon Wing
feeds.description: Nylon Wing is a paragliding adventures of an ex-skydiver. For more than 15 years I regularly jumped from aeroplanes. I was involved in competition overseas and eventually instructed first timers to make that life-changing leap. Paragliding was always on my mind and was the obvious choice as a way of enjoying un-powered flight in the mountainous environment near my home.

feeds.title: Nicole McLearn Blog
feeds.description: The blog is managed by Nicole McLearn, a Canadian female paragliding champion since 2003, ranked 3rd overall in Canada, and a member of Team Canada. She holds the Canadian female distance XC record as well as the altitude gain record. Go through e blog and learn about her paragliding and flying adventures across the world.

feeds.title: Global Paragliding
feeds.description: Follow this blog and get info & location guides on Paragliding.

feeds.title: Flybubble Paragliding Blog
feeds.description: A blog about Paragliding, Paramotoring, Hang Gliding, Speed Flying, Freeflight, Equipments and more. Flybubble is a freeflight equipment retailer and flying training centre based in the UK, specialising in personal attention and outstanding service. They stock a wide range and offer expert buying advice, fittings, demo flights, part exchanges and used gear.

feeds.title: Ozone Paragliders
feeds.description: Ozone paragliders is one of the world's leading paraglider manufacturers & distributors. It started as a group of pilots with an idea. Build wings that just do everything better: handle better, turn tighter, glide faster, & are more comfortable to fly. Balance all those together, and never compromise. The result is something most pilots can only dream of: the most potent fun factor in paragliding.

feeds.title: Birdmen Paragliding Blog
feeds.description: Birdmen Paragliding is a great source for paragliding in Cape Town and the surrounding areas. Birdmen Paragliding is based in the Northern suburbs of Cape Town and is owned and run by Barry Pedersen.

feeds.title: TryFly
feeds.description: TryFly is a paragliding website.
